observations: Photo 0: a white and pink portable domestic electric sewing machine, stitch dials on the front, brand text on the pink panel faint (looks like 'RICCAR'), thread and lace under the foot.
Photo 1: a different machine, white portable domestic sewing machine with 'Semco' and 'indigo 6' printed on the front; plastic looks slightly yellowed; a 'SINGER Computer' machine sits behind it.
Photo 2: a third machine, white portable domestic sewing machine labelled 'NOVAMATIC' and 'NM 868A', German and French stitch labels.
All three are free-arm household machines with built-in motors, not industrial machines (no table, no separate clutch or servo motor, no large head).
Background in all photos shows a shop with many other sewing machines; watermark 'MARTEX GLOBAL' on every photo.
No photo shows a machine powered on, sewing, the foot pedal, the power cord, a receipt or a warranty card.

identity.kind: used domestic portable electric sewing machine

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1 and 2 show small portable household machines, not industrial machines.

claims.claim: For sewing clothes and multipurpose uses
claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show working-type domestic sewing machines with stitch selectors.
Photo 1 plastic is yellowed and photo 0 has thread and lace left in it; these are used imported machines.
No photo can prove a machine was never opened.
No clip of any machine sewing.

risks.risk: Three different machines are shown; it is not clear which one is for sale.

risks.if_unproven: as the most worn of the three domestic machines

risks.risk: Foot pedal, power cord or accessories may be missing; imported machines may need a step-down transformer.
